gameRules.name: Rotor Locksmith
gameRules.mechanic: Three geared rings, held inward/outward motion, continuous-contact stopping, persistent damage and enlarged key return.
gameRules.task: Acquire the core key and carry its complete envelope back to the exit before durability or time runs out.

ordinary.scope: Three ordinary win attempts and three public natural-loss attempts; stop at the first mismatch. Every valid call is one real full interval including locked/quarantine/terminal ticks. Total call cap is public timeBudgetTicks+60; exceeding the actual terminal budget is preserved failure, never a fabricated loss. Public projection removes only top-level pilotDiagnostics. No extra strategy/cadence matrix or rerun.

independent.scope: Independent interval arithmetic over all saved actual ordinary ticks; no Model import, input replay, route search or private diagnostics. Strict collision membership is separate from numeric output comparison. The binary64 submission maximum is recomputed from discrete monotone preimages. Root and event geometry, damage, clocks, key return, exact bank prefixes and public adjacent-frame references are checked. Message text is checked only as a string because the public contract does not specify its wording. Host pause, invalid-dt fixtures, physical hardware and every browser animation frame are outside these six headless ordinary cases.

formalBoundaryTests.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

nonBlockingFindings.observation: Each image visibly has a 0.1-second difference between host and canvas timer text: 73.4/73.3 and 59.2/59.1 respectively.
nonBlockingFindings.assessment: The public capture-window facts document continued held radial input and naturally advancing model ticks. These timer displays are consistent with the respective rounded time windows; no precise same-tick or same-frame synchronization is claimed. The visible task/key/integrity/resistance state is not contradictory. No change is requested for this scoped visual acceptance.

peerReviewLimitations: The raw candidate report contains private diagnostics and was not read. Its hash is an association supplied by root, not a claim of independent raw-report inspection.

The four live screenshots cover advancing windows. The recorded range endpoints and permanent history do not identify an exact model tick for every image pixel or prove that a boundary event occurred at that pixel instant.
This review does not assert timer synchronization on arbitrary frames or continuous visual correctness between the twelve selected images.
A visible pause or victory screen establishes its presentation here, not independently measured clock freezing, input delivery, an earned browser outcome or mathematical gameplay correctness.
No browser rerun, Model execution, source inspection, candidate APK installation, video review or physical-device test was performed.
The LOCAL phone-connection panel is readable in the screenshots; this review makes no controller pairing or hardware functionality claim.
candidate.scope: One actual browser round. Four moving-image windows retain both endpoints; no pixel is assigned an exact model tick. Source-art correction history is separate.

gameRules.scope: The independent full-tick ordinary audit owns continuous collision geometry. Release checks bind saved facts and receipts. Numerical submission reduction was not observed in ordinary play; its formal fixtures do not expand ordinary coverage. Browser controller transport, controlled TV input fixtures and QR layout remain separate from physical hardware.

modelTests.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

checks.name: P freezes gameplay state and tick, P resumes
R restarts with clean simulation state
resizing keeps canvas and complete sidebar text visible
no page, console or resource errors
three actual menus expose all ring geometry, coupling, key return, durability and held controls
actual controller joystick and A/B dual contacts hold, independently release and cancel through real WebSocket messages
actual controller values and native Enter drive continuous motion; A+B stop radius while rotation and independent B return remain live
cancel suppresses held rotation and radial motion while time advances; partial neutral cannot release quarantine
disconnect freezes the complete model; explicit reconnect resume isolates stale held A until real full neutral
P freezes rotor angles, radius, damage and clock; the 960 glass fits and resume requires full neutral
ordinary L1 repeated wall contacts naturally exhaust durability after actual impact locks and neutral releases
R rebuilds initial radius, angles, health, key and empty receipt banks before actual neutral acknowledgement
separate QR room-info layout fixture fits complete text at both TV sizes

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryRotorTraversal.scope: Actual keyboard dispatches including menu navigation, permanent contact/travel receipts and sparse position, unwrapped angle, key, damage and clock observations. Held controls do not imply one command or receipt per press. Boundary receipts prove arrival, not complete traversal; task fraction and physical endpoint arrival remain separate. Full observed lastStep/ringChecks values retain analytic roots and actual submitted motionFraction without reconstruction. Missing local events and intervening intervals remain explicit. Host ticks, model ticks and wall observation seconds are distinct. Real controller-page integration and full-tick independent geometry audit remain separate evidence.

secondNonBlockingFindings.assessment: These five images visibly have 0.1-second host/canvas timer differences. The other visible mission/key/integrity/resistance fields are not contradictory. The differences remain documented; acceptance does not claim exact same-frame synchronization or request an additional capture.

secondReviewLimitations: This is a visual review of exactly the listed 21 original images. It does not assert continuous visual correctness between them or inspect every encoded video frame.

Receipt-clock anchors and permanent history in the public frames manifest are distinct from the visible pixel state. No exact tick, input edge, crossing, pickup instant or contact fraction is assigned to an image.
The five encoded gameplay radii are transcriptions of the displayed values, including their display rounding; they are not independent physical measurements or replacements for model observations.
Room QR images use a reserved-address layout fixture. No scan success, controller pairing, physical television legibility or hardware functionality was tested or inferred.
Paused, victory and loss screens establish their presentation here; these pixels alone do not independently prove clock freezing, input delivery, earned outcomes or mathematical correctness.
No raw recording, pilot, production Model or private diagnostics were read, and no browser, Model, validator or media pipeline was executed for this review.
The public frames manifest was read before its personal-review flags were updated. Its recorded SHA identifies that exact version; this reviewer did not modify flags, images, sources or helpers.

ordinaryCaseSourceHistory.scope: First six actual ordinary-input cases. Public projections omit only pilotDiagnostics; original/source hashes remain bound. Consolidation replays no game.

controllerEvidence.scope: Browser-emulated joystick plus upper INWARD A / lower OUTWARD B contacts produce trusted PointerEvents on the unchanged signed-asset controller.html/js; the controlled WebSocket server records actual outgoing strings. Held checks prove stable transport without release/repress, not rotor collision, travel or Model input-isolation results. TV input-bridge/model checks are separate; no physical phone hardware or production Android server is tested.

actualGameplay.recordedScopeNote: Actual browser held input, permanent contact/travel receipts and sparse radius, unwrapped angle, key, durability/resistance and clock observations. Raw key counts include menu navigation and do not count continuous movement or receipt events. Boundary arrivals are not complete ring traversal proofs; task fraction and physical arrival fraction remain separate. Original lastStep/ringChecks preserve analytic roots and actual motionFraction; missing intervals and local events are not reconstructed. The complete ordinary independent geometry audit is separate. The approved recipe and actually observed terminal hold are bound. Actual controller-page/WebSocket integration is separately recorded alongside controlled TV-bridge fixtures; neither proves physical hardware. Original reception order, derived encoding mapping and real empty error arrays remain factual. The existing full decode is reused once; no recording recovery is assumed.

controller.scope: Browser-emulated joystick plus upper INWARD A / lower OUTWARD B contacts produce trusted PointerEvents on the unchanged signed-asset controller.html/js; the controlled WebSocket server records actual outgoing strings. TV input-bridge/model checks are separate; no physical phone hardware or production Android server is tested.
controller.controlledTvScope: Actual recorded WS values enter an explicitly controlled TV snapshot bridge. Native keyboard inputs are recorded separately. No production Android room server or physical phone is tested; transport timestamps are not replayed as a timing route.

browserInputEvidence.qrScope: Four synthetic address-layout fixtures; no scan, live pairing or physical-device claim.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
